001package org.clafer.math;
002
003import gnu.trove.iterator.TIntObjectIterator;
004import gnu.trove.map.TIntObjectMap;
005import gnu.trove.map.hash.TIntObjectHashMap;
006import java.util.ArrayList;
007import java.util.List;
008import java.util.function.IntFunction;
009import org.clafer.domain.Domain;
010
011/**
012 *
013 * @author jimmy
014 */
015public class SetTheory extends SetEnvironment {
016
017    private final BaseDomainMap envs = new BaseDomainMap();
018    private final List<SetEnvironment[]> constructiveDisjunctions = new ArrayList<>();
019
020    public Domain getEnv(int v) {
021        return envs.get(v);
022    }
023
024    public void constructiveDisjunction(SetEnvironment... disjunction) {
025        if (disjunction.length <= 1) {
026            throw new IllegalArgumentException();
027        }
028        constructiveDisjunctions.add(disjunction);
029    }
030
031    public boolean propagate() {
032        boolean propagated = false;
033        boolean changed;
034        do {
035            changed = propagate(envs, this);
036            // Handle the constructive conjunctions.
037            for (SetEnvironment[] constructiveDisjunction : constructiveDisjunctions) {
038                assert constructiveDisjunction.length > 0;
039                // The alternate disjunctions.
040                SubDomainMap[] disjunction = new SubDomainMap[constructiveDisjunction.length];
041                int i = 0;
042                for (SetEnvironment conjunction : constructiveDisjunction) {
043                    SubDomainMap conjunctionEnv = new SubDomainMap(envs);
044                    propagate(conjunctionEnv, conjunction, this);
045                    disjunction[i++] = conjunctionEnv;
046                }
047                assert i == disjunction.length;
048
049                // Merge the alternate disjunctions by union.
050                TIntObjectIterator<Domain> iterator = disjunction[0].map.iterator();
051                while (iterator.hasNext()) {
052                    iterator.advance();
053
054                    int key = iterator.key();
055                    Domain union = iterator.value();
056                    for (int j = 1; j < disjunction.length && union != null; j++) {
057                        Domain domain = disjunction[j].get(key);
058                        union = domain == null ? null : union.union(domain);
059                    }
060                    // Merge back into the main environment by intersection.
061                    if (union != null) {
062                        changed |= envs.put(key, union);
063                    }
064                }
065            }
066            propagated |= changed;
067        } while (changed);
068        return propagated;
069    }
070
071    private static boolean propagate(DomainMap map, SetEnvironment... environments) {
072        boolean propagated = false;
073        for (SetEnvironment environment : environments) {
074            for (SubsetDomain subset : environment.subsetDomains) {
075                propagated |= map.put(subset.sub, subset.sup);
076            }
077        }
078        boolean changed;
079        do {
080            changed = false;
081            for (SetEnvironment environment : environments) {
082                for (Subset subset : environment.subsets) {
083                    Domain supEnv = map.get(subset.sup);
084                    if (supEnv != null) {
085                        changed |= map.put(subset.sub, supEnv);
086                    }
087                }
088                for (Union union : environment.unions) {
089                    int[] operands = union.operands;
090                    Domain unionDomain = map.get(operands[0]);
091                    for (int i = 1; i < operands.length && unionDomain != null; i++) {
092                        Domain next = map.get(operands[i]);
093                        unionDomain = next == null ? null : unionDomain.union(next);
094                    }
095                    if (unionDomain != null) {
096                        changed |= map.put(union.union, unionDomain);
097                    }
098                    unionDomain = map.get(union.union);
099                    if (unionDomain != null) {
100                        for (int i = 0; i < operands.length; i++) {
101                            changed |= map.put(operands[i], unionDomain);
102                        }
103                    }
104                }
105            }
106            propagated |= changed;
107        } while (changed);
108        return propagated;
109    }
110
111    public String toString(IntFunction<Object> mapper) {
112        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
113        result.append("===ENV===\n");
114        for (TIntObjectIterator iter = envs.map.iterator(); iter.hasNext();) {
115            iter.advance();
116            result.append("  ").append(mapper.apply(iter.key())).append(" subset of ").append(iter.value()).append('\n');
117        }
118        result.append("===UNION===\n");
119        for (Union union : unions) {
120            result.append("  ").append(mapper.apply(union.union)).append(" = union(");
121            for (int i = 0; i < union.operands.length; i++) {
122                if (i > 0) {
123                    result.append(", ");
124                }
125                result.append(mapper.apply(union.operands[i]));
126            }
127            result.append(")\n");
128        }
129        result.append("===SUBSET===\n");
130        for (Subset subset : subsets) {
131            result.append("  ").append(mapper.apply(subset.sub)).append(" subset of ").append(mapper.apply(subset.sup)).append('\n');
132        }
133        return result.toString();
134    }
135
136    public static SetEnvironment or() {
137        return new SetEnvironment();
138    }
139
140    private static interface DomainMap {
141
142        Domain get(int v);
143
144        boolean put(int v, Domain domain);
145    }
146
147    private static class BaseDomainMap implements DomainMap {
148
149        final TIntObjectMap<Domain> map = new TIntObjectHashMap<>();
150
151        @Override
152        public Domain get(int v) {
153            return map.get(v);
154        }
155
156        @Override
157        public boolean put(int v, Domain domain) {
158            Domain prev = get(v);
159            if (prev == null) {
160                map.put(v, domain);
161                return true;
162            }
163            Domain intersection = prev.intersection(domain);
164            if (prev.equals(intersection)) {
165                return false;
166            }
167            map.put(v, intersection);
168            return true;
169        }
170    }
171
172    private static class SubDomainMap implements DomainMap {
173
174        final BaseDomainMap baseMap;
175        final TIntObjectMap<Domain> map = new TIntObjectHashMap<>();
176
177        SubDomainMap(BaseDomainMap baseMap) {
178            this.baseMap = baseMap;
179        }
180
181        @Override
182        public Domain get(int v) {
183            Domain domain = map.get(v);
184            return domain == null ? baseMap.get(v) : domain;
185        }
186
187        @Override
188        public boolean put(int v, Domain domain) {
189            Domain prev = get(v);
190            if (prev == null) {
191                map.put(v, domain);
192                return true;
193            }
194            Domain intersection = prev.intersection(domain);
195            if (prev.equals(intersection)) {
196                return false;
197            }
198            map.put(v, intersection);
199            return true;
200        }
201    }
202}
